description: Implementation of the NetworkDelegate class handling network request lifecycle events, cookies, and privacy settings in Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: NetworkDelegate
classes.description: Handles network request events, cookies, and privacy policies within Chromium's networking stack.

methods.name: NotifyBeforeURLRequest
methods.description: Called before a URL request is sent, allowing modifications or checks.

methods.name: NotifyBeforeStartTransaction
methods.description: Called before starting a transaction, with request headers.

methods.name: NotifyHeadersReceived
methods.description: Called when response headers are received.

methods.name: NotifyResponseStarted
methods.description: Called when a response has started.

methods.name: NotifyURLRequestDestroyed
methods.description: Called when a URL request is destroyed.

methods.name: CanSetCookie
methods.description: Determines if a cookie can be set for a request.

methods.name: ForcePrivacyMode
methods.description: Determines privacy mode for a request.

methods.name: CancelURLRequestWithPolicyViolatingReferrerHeader
methods.description: Cancels requests with policy-violating referrer headers.

methods.name: CanQueueReportingReport
methods.description: Checks if a reporting report can be queued.

methods.name: CanSendReportingReports
methods.description: Checks if reporting reports can be sent.

methods.name: CanSetReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if a reporting client can be set.

methods.name: CanUseReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if a reporting client can be used.

methods.name: GetFirstPartySetsCacheFilterMatchInfoMaybeAsync
methods.description: Gets cache filter match info asynchronously.
